notes.text: Read from the DP map of Route 201 (1040 x 320 px). The tile grid starts 8 px in from the left edge: tile (x, y) covers pixels [8 + 16x, 24 + 16x) x [16y, 16y + 16). Trees sit about 3 px lower on their tiles than on the Route 202 map; tall grass and the Potion giver fit a grid with no vertical offset.
Trees: tiles under trunks or mostly under a canopy are blocked.
Ledges: row 10 west of the tall grass (unchecked), and (53..56, 7) in the north-east, which is one row higher than it looks on the DP map, as on Route 202.
Exits: west edge rows 9..12 to Lake Verity; south gap (14..17, 19) to Twinleaf Town; east edge rows 3..6 to Sandgem Town. The Lake Verity and Twinleaf offsets are not known.
No trainers. The other NPCs wander; the girl in the tall grass still needs a wander rectangle, measured on the console.
The Potion giver is at (44, 3) on the DP map but stands at (43, 3) on the console, in the top grass row.
